name: Nature’s Wrath (Achievement)
body:
You have actively sought to destroy the abominations of the world and have learned how to anticipate their common physical attacks.

Prerequisite: Wild shape class feature. While in animal, elemental, or plant form, kill or assist in killing 25 creatures with the aberration type whose CR is equal to or greater than your level.

Benefit: While in animal, elemental, or plant form, you receive a +4 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Defense whenever an opponent tries to grapple you.
